header.running_head: 3. The Rights and Duties of Muslims

blocks.tamil_translation: — indeed Allah is the Accepter of repentance, Most Merciful. O mankind, indeed We created you from a male and a female; and We made you into many branches and many tribes so that you may come to know one another; (whoever you may be) indeed the most honoured of you in the sight of Allah is the one of you who fears (Him) most; indeed Allah is All-Knowing, fully Aware (of all matters).

blocks.text: Note:- Allah Ta'ala has described backbiting as equal to eating the flesh of a dead brother. Just as tearing off and eating a man's flesh piece by piece causes him pain, so too backbiting about a Muslim causes him pain. Just as a dead man does not feel the effect of the pain, so too the one who was backbitten does not suffer pain as long as he does not know the details of the backbiting.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالى: (يآيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ امَنُوْا كُوْنُوْا قَوَّامِيْنَ بِالْقِسْطِ شُهَدَاءَ لِلّهِ وَلَوْ عَلَى اَنْفُسِكُمْ اَوِ الْوَالِدَيْنِ وَاْلاَقْرَبِيْنَ ۚ اِنْ يَكُنْ غَنِيًّا اَوْ فَقِيْرًا فَاللهُ اَوْلى بِهِمَا قف فَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا الْهَوَى اَنْ تَعْدِلُوْا ۚ وَاِنْ تَلْوُوْا اَوْ تُعْرِضُوْا فَاِنَّ اللهَ كَانَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُوْنَ خَبِيْرًا۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: O you who believe, be steadfast in justice — witnesses for Allah (bearing witness to the truth); (even if that testimony is) against yourselves, or (your) parents, or (your) relatives — (whether the one against whom you testify) is rich or poor (it is the same), for Allah is (in seeking the good of) both of them
